meta.name: Approximate search · polynomial advice
meta.metric: Approximation guarantee γ(n); polynomial query time
meta.regime: Euclidean search CVPP with polynomial-size lattice-dependent advice and polynomial query time
meta.rules: Return a lattice vector within factor γ(n) of optimal for every target. Preprocessing depends only on the lattice and is not charged as query time. Record advice size separately. A polynomial query bound has no numeric 2^{cn} score. Distance estimation and bounded-distance promises belong in separate variants.
